prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after pet adoption (+16.8% vs +12.0%) and adding cloud storage backup copy (+4.9% vs +0.5%) were helpful and exceeded predictions, while sign-in hints, progress trackers, and moving sign-in before launch showed no clear effect.
Dynamic waiting screen additions (progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), while static time estimates, checklists, audio selectors, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Photo quality tips were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), whereas adoption certificate redesigns severely hurt performance (-27.5%) and card layout changes showed no clear effect.
Desktop mascot audio redesign on the finish screen was helpful (+7.5% vs -3.0%), but finish screen control guides, notification prompts, owner badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
All welcome path selection changes (copy, layout, and direct selection cards) showed no clear effect, with predictions consistently over-estimating impact.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +6.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -15.0% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +0.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, new_screen: +3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, incentive: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +7.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 6 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +4.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: -1.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 85.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Companion Sound Preview Component: Redesign the friend picker screen with interactive pet sound preview buttons and a playful layout so users hear sound effects while choosing their companion. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the main setup (63.8%) and long mean time (1017s); previous audio and sound quality additions produced significant positive lifts.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Voice Pitch Customizer Screen: Insert a new companion voice pitch customization screen before adoption confirmation, letting users test and set their pet audio tone. (why: Adoption takes a long average duration (1017s), and users engage strongly with pet audio customization features.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Preparation Interactive Audio Activity: Add an interactive sound-and-visual background activity to the waiting screen where users tap ambient sound nodes while generation completes. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s); dynamic audio-visual waiting features previously boosted conversion (+9.3%).)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Account Creation After Waiting Screen: Reorder the sign_in screen to happen after pet generation waiting completes, right before launching to the desktop intro. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in, and moving sign-in later previously increased conversion.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Recovery Assurance Headline: Update headline and messaging on sign_in to explicitly guarantee existing pets and customized data will restore seamlessly. (why: 8 support emails were received last week regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Audio Generation Progress Indicator: Display a real-time audio waveform animation and hint on the waiting screen showing companion voice generation status. (why: Waiting step dropoff is high (86.5% home, 201s median) and dynamic visual progress indicators were proven effective.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop App Taskbar Pinning Hint: Add an explicit hint and badge component on the finish screen explaining where the pet app icon lives in the desktop system tray. (why: Support receives multiple emails (3 emails) reporting that pets do not show on desktop or users cannot re-open the app.)
7: [finish, redesign] Mascot Soundboard Finish Screen Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a mascot soundboard preview where users test different pet voice buttons before launching to desktop. (why: Finish screen dropoff is 73.2% with 395s median time; desktop mascot audio welcome features generated +7.5% lift previously.)
